woman in front passenger window | leaning out just aft of the A-pillar, arms crossed on the door sill, window glass down | same window, same pose, same anchor point in every frame | no wrong-side emergence; body stays correctly occluded by door/A-pillar geometry

desert highway | paved surface with yellow center dashes, dirt shoulder at bottom-left, road ahead recedes to upper-left | same layout in all frames | progressively more of the road ahead revealed as the camera moves toward the car's side, geometrically consistent

fender-mounted antenna + hood ornament | thin antenna and chrome ornament forward of the windshield on the hood/fender | maintain the same position relative to the cowl and A-pillar in every frame | apparent leftward drift in frame matches camera translation
windshield, A-pillar, rearview mirror | glass forward of the woman, mirror hanging at top center of glass | mirror tracks the windshield exactly across the dolly | no parallax decoupling
roof rack | twin chrome rails running along the roof top | present and aligned in all frames | consistent with wagon body

background (desert scrub, distant mountains, utility pole from ~00:06) | horizon at upper-left, pole stands beyond the far pavement edge | unchanged | no background element ever renders over the car or the woman; occlusion ordering (car > road > desert > mountains) holds throughout
